tagline: Nine miles toward Morongo, with desert water beyond.
intro: At the eastern end of San Gorgonio Pass, Route 62 leaves Interstate 10 and heads north toward Morongo Valley. Its designated scenic stretch ends at the San Bernardino County line, long before Twentynine Palms. The stretch from White Water to Morongo Valley joined the state highway system in 1935.

Beyond the designated stretch, Big Morongo Canyon Preserve makes a separate excursion from Morongo Valley. There the Morongo fault turns water draining from the mountains into a creek and a marsh, and a spring-fed oasis of cottonwoods and willows.

moments.title: San Gorgonio Pass
moments.text: At the eastern end of the pass, the highway turns north from Interstate 10 toward Morongo Valley.

moments.title: Big Morongo Canyon Preserve
moments.text: Off Route 62 in Morongo Valley, short marsh trails enter a spring-fed oasis where the Morongo fault gathers water draining from the mountains into a creek and marsh.
